messages:
rachel: deploy-bot launched a tiny canary (v2026.05.02-canary) to eu-west at 7%. dashboard showing a sudden p99 bump on /v1/generate. anyone online?

deploy-bot: deploy event: v2026.05.02-canary -> service/inference-eu (traffic=7%). run: https://deploys.redwood/3854321000

sre_oncall: looking now. p99 jumped from ~140ms -> ~1.0s at ~3854320955. traces show a cluster of short requests queuing; KV cache hit-rate OK. this release flips runtime flag smart_coalescing=true.

marco: that flag can increase aggregation window under low load which sometimes hurts very short requests. recommend stopping ramp and pinning to stable while we check.

ops_lead: +1 stop and pin. keep canary nodes up for debug. avoid immediate model rollback until infra checks done.

ivy: agree. I'll prepare the revert command for the flag and perf-capture steps. also propose we add a temporary traffic hold note to release notes.

rachel: consensus call: STOP ramp -> set canary traffic 0% in eu-west -> investigate -> revert smart_coalescing on canary if infra implicated -> retest at 5% after 10m stable. objections?

sre_oncall: vote: stop. will attach traces with rollout_id=3854321000 and collect GPU scheduling histograms.

deploy-bot: action: traffic update requested by rachel. setting v2026.05.02-canary traffic to 0% in eu-west. (req_id=rb-3854321000-01)

marco: prepping patch: ```kubectl patch configmap infra-flags -n inference --type=merge -p '{"data":{"smart_coalescing":"false"}}'``` will apply to canary infra group only.

ivy: go ahead and stage; I'll apply on confirmation from SRE.

sre_oncall: evidence aligns with increased coalescing windows; please revert on canary infra.

marco: applying patch to canary infra now. monitor window 3m.

deploy-bot: config patch applied to infra config for inference-eu(canary). monitor window initiated.

sre_oncall: p99 trending down toward baseline within ~80s of patch. tagging this run: incident=3854321000-canary-hold.

ops_lead: good. keep traffic at 0% for 10m. if stable, ramp to 5% with coalescing disabled and observe for 15m before proceeding.

iris: (not in participants) posted SRE note in run: "no model rollback; infra flag reverted on canary; awaiting stability window"

ivy: adding quick note to release draft: "Canary paused in EU due to transient p99 tail; smart_coalescing disabled on canary infra while we validate."

rachel: thanks all. will update product and schedule a short retrospective in case we need flag gating in future releases. :thumbsup:
